Carry a sampling window from one drawn tile to the next. Put each number into a single viewing aperture in order.
Run two separate, numbered sequences simultaneously. Freeze the faster one on its forty-fifth card while its neighbor continues.
Leave both clock settings visible beside the catalog identifiers. Hold on the unanswered historical interval.
